messages:
lina: FYI seeing a big provisioning spike in ap-south-1, lots of nodes falling back to hosted due to BMC image rejects. Started ~06:45 UTC.
trent: :eyes: any error lines?
lina: log snippet from the provisioner: 
```
ERROR apply-image bmc-322: image verification failed: signature mismatch (key-id=unknown, expected rsa-202403)
```
marcos: we rotated the HSM CA keys last night (02:22). I pushed the new signer certs to eu/us, but I didn't finish the AP region rollout because of the throttles.
anjali: ohhh. so ap-south-1 BMCs are trying to validate images signed with the old key?
marcos: looks like the images were re-signed with the new key, but the BMCs still have the old public key in the firmware verify table -> mismatch.
trent: any BMCs flipping secure-boot state? that could explain some weird fallbacks we saw earlier.
lina: yes, a handful reported secure-boot toggled to 'disabled' after the failed apply and then re-enabled by our watchdog, which confused the provisioner and caused a double-retry.
ryan: side-effect: autoscaler pushed more ephemeral capacity to avoid queuing, so we're burning hosted GPU hours. Preliminary cost hit ~USD 4.2k for last 6 hours in ap-south-1.
anjali: timeline + rollout plan?
marcos: immediate plan: 1) push the public key bundle to AP nodes (hotfix) 2) re-sign the active images with backward-compatible key (we have an intermediate key) 3) restart provisioner service in ap-south-1 4) monitor for rejects for 30m then re-enable strict signature check.
lina: can we gate the provisioner so it doesn't disable secure-boot when it gets these errors? that toggling is causing nodes to boot into a weird state and hold GPUs offline.
trent: yes, we can flip behavior to treat verification failures as hard fail (no secure-boot toggle) while we propagate keys. short patch: set PROVISION_SAFE_FALLBACK=false on the provisioner deployment for ap-south-1.
marcos: pushing the key bundle now to the region: `scp keys/ap-south1/pubbundle.json bmc-updater:~` then running `bmc-update-public-keys --apply`.
deploy-bot: deploy started for bmc-key-bundle-ap-south1 by marcos at 07:12 UTC. CI job 6721.
lina: marcos pinged — can you also re-sign the image artifacts and upload under the backward-compatible tag? minimal downtime if we do both.
marcos: re-sign in progress: `./sign-image --key intermediate.pem --in model-v2.img --out model-v2-rs.img`
anjali: CS heads, please prepare a short customer note in case tenants in ap-south-1 saw degraded batch jobs. No need for a public incident yet unless SLA thresholds hit.
ryan: I'll open an internal incident and add cost estimates. tagging billing and cloud-costs.
trent: post-mortem action: automate HSM key propagation to region update-runbook and add a canary test that validates BMC public key after rotation. Also add a safety to the provisioner to not toggle secure-boot on signature mismatch.
lina: confirmed re-signed image uploaded and provisioner restarted with PROVISION_SAFE_FALLBACK=false. Monitoring logs.
lina: quick log after change: 
```
INFO provisioner: 07:25 applying image model-v2-rs.img to bmc-322 -> ok
INFO provisioner: 07:27 12 nodes provisioned, queue drained
```
marcos: keys propagated and verified on 98% of BMCs in ap-south-1 (small set still exchanging, retrying).
anjali: can we estimate the residual cost impact for the rest of the 24h window? Ryan?
ryan: ballpark another $1.1k if autoscaler stays elevated for 8 more hours; we should cancel extra capacity once the queue is stable.
trent: ok to revert PROVISION_SAFE_FALLBACK to true after 1h of stable telemetry, and then run a slow rollout for stricter checks.
lina: agreed. I'll watch the dashboard and post if anything odd.
marcos: follow-up runbook updates: add step to verify `fwupdmgr get-devices` public key fingerprint and `ipmi chassis status` secure-boot flag. I'll draft and attach.
anjali: thanks all. great cross-team response. :thumbsup:
ryan: incident created: IN-2026-4512, linking this thread. I'll update cost and customer comms if anything changes.
lina: closing thread, will post a short summary to #incidents after the 1h stabilisation window.
